stories.title: Gukesh and Sindarov draw Game 2 of world chess championship in just 20 moves
summary: Game 2 ends by threefold repetition in 1hr 57minWorld champion opens with the London SystemSindarov plays with white in Game 3 on ThursdayAll your Gukesh v Sindarov questions, answeredIndia’s Gukesh Dommaraju and Uzbekistan’s Javokhir Sindarov drew the second game of their world chess championship match in only 20 moves and 1hr 57min on Wednesday, leaving the score level at 1–all at the Fondation Martin Bodmer in the Geneva suburbs.The quiet encounter was one of the shortest classical world title games since the sport’s rival championships were reunified in 2006 and the first to finish in under two hours since Ding Liren and Ian Nepomniachtchi drew their 11th game in just over 100 minutes in Astana in 2023.
